comparison.objective: Join two boards evenly over three glued dowels.
comparison.physical_skill: Multi-pin alignment and balanced pressing to prevent a wedged or skewed joint.
comparison.success_condition: Both seam corners within 0.5 mm, edges flush, boards flat, released and still for 1 s.
comparison.reason: Multi-dowel mating is precision rigid assembly; it lacks loose-body segregation through apertures and simultaneous retained-item preservation.
